content: GetROS2ImageTool subscribes to a sensor_msgs/Image (or CompressedImage) topic, pulls one frame, and returns it as a multimodal LangChain message the agent's VLM backend can consume directly in the same tool-call turn -- this is RAI's 'what do you see' path. A Get360ImageTool variant exists for 360 camera topics. Tool access is scoped by the same readable-topic allow-list as other ROS2 tools. Source: robotecai.github.io/rai/tutorials/tools/, RobotecAI/rai-manipulation-demo docs.
